selection: minimum V_select ADE + 0.5 * FDE; strict improvement
development_gate: Directed-context must improve both ADE and FDE from the same best-J checkpoint before multi-seed confirmation.
limitation: Single-seed V_select development comparison of fresh inherited QGNN versus fresh directed-context QGNN. J selects one checkpoint; ADE and FDE are reported separately. Strong GNN is historical matched-protocol context only. No V_confirm/test access, QGAT training, or quantum-advantage claim.
